title: A major scale box
summary: Follow a compact route across strings.

steps.title: A major scale box
steps.body:
**scale box** means a compact group of fret positions used to play a scale across nearby strings. It is a route to the notes, not a different scale. This G major box stays between frets 2 and 5 on strings 6, 5 and 4.

**Why it matters:** Crossing strings can avoid a long reach along one string. The same correct sounds still count in other positions.

steps.title: Find the notes
steps.body: Follow the numbered route: string 6 frets 3, 5; string 5 frets 2, 3, 5; string 4 frets 2, 4, 5. Play one position at a time, in order.

items.prompt: Play G, A, B, C, D, E, F#, G in that order, one note at a time.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Play just the first two positions, then the first five, then all eight. Keep your wrist comfortable; speed can wait.
